spans.s:
(औ ईर) औदृशिर r. 1st cl. (पश्यति)
To see.
With उत् prefixed,
1 To see, to observe.
2 To anticipate, to foresee.
3 To doubt, to think doubtingly.

f. (-शा)
The eye.
E.
see दृश, टाप् being here added.

mfn. (-दृक्)
1 A seer, a looker.
2 Wise, possessed of knowledge.
f. (-दृक्)
1 The eye.
2 Sight, seeing.
E.
दृश to see, affix क्विप्; also दृशा and दृशि, &c.

f. (-शद् or शत्)
1 A stone, a rock.
2 A flat stone for grinding condiments upon.
E.
दॄ to divide, Uṇādi affix अदि, augment षुक्, and ष changed to श; the crude form may also be दृषत् or दृषट्, &c.

f. (-षद् or षत्)
1 A stone or rock.
2 A flat stone or plate on which spices, &c. are ground.
E.
दॄ to divide, Uṇādi affix अदि, and षुक् augment; also दृशद्.

f. (-ती)
1 The name of a river which forms the eastern boundary of the Āryavarta or holy land of the Hindus, running on the north-east of

Delhi.
2

A name of the goddess DURGĀ.
E.
दृशद् a stone or rock, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-ङ्क्ष्य)
A lotus, or rather a kind of nelumbium.
E.
दृश the eye, काङ्क्ष्य to desire, with आङ् prefix, and यत् affix; desirable as an object of comparison to the eye.

n. (-नं)
Light.
m. (-नः)
1 The name of an Asura; also

VIROCANA.
2

A holy or spiritual teacher.
3 A king, a ruler, a protector or cherisher of the world.
4 A Brahman.
E.
दृश to see, आनच् Uṇādi affix; by whom or which sight, &c. is enjoyed.

f. (-शिः or शी)
The eye.
2 A Śāstra.
E.
दृश to see, affix कि, ङीष् is optionally added.

n. (-मं)
The white lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.)
E.
दृशा the eye, उपमा resemblance; what resembles the eye.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
1 Visible, to be seen.
2 Beautiful, pleasing.
m. (-श्यः)
(In Arithmetic,) A given quantity or number.
E.
दृश to see, यत् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Vision, sight.
E.
त्व added to the last.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Seen, visible, apparent.
n. (-ष्टं)
Obvious danger or calamity.
E.
दृश to see, affix क्त.

n. (-टं)
A riddle, an enigma.
E.
दृष्ट seen, कूट trick.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Found out, exposed, detected.
E.
दृष्ट, and दोष fault.

f. (-जाः)
A girl arrived at puberty.
E.
दृष्ट seen, (by whom,) and रजस् the menstrual discharge.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Seeing, beholding, having seen.
E.
दृश to see, क्तवतु aff.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A science, a Śāstra.
2 An example, an illustration.
3 Death, dying.
E.
दृष्ट obvious or seen, and अन्त end.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 The eye.
2 Sight, seeing.
3 Knowledge, wisdom.
4 The sight of the eye, the pupil.
5 Aspect, (of the stars.)
E.
दृश to see, affix क्तिन्.

n. (-कृत्)
A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
E.
दृष्टि the eye, कृ to make, here meaning resemble; affix क्विप् and तुक् added; also with क्त affix दृष्टिकृत n. (-तं.)

m. (-णः)
A butt, a mark for archers, &c.
E.
दृष्टि the eye, and गुण object.

m. (-तः)
A look, a look at or on.
E.
दृष्टि, and निपात alighting.

m. (-तः)
A look, a glance.
E.
दृष्टि, and पात falling.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Kept pure by the sight, i.
E.
watched, that no impropriety is committed, or impurity contracted.
E.
दृष्टि, and पूत purified.

m. (-न्धुः)
A fire-fly.
E.
दृष्टि sight, and बन्धु a friend.

m. (-पः)
A leer, a side glance.
E.
दृष्टि the eye, विक्षेप casting.

m. (-षः)
A snake.
E.
दृष्टि, and विष poison, venomous in his look.

ind.
Having seen.
E.
दृश to see, क्त्वा aff.
